card.name: Ends of split drug-class names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long drug or drug-class name split into parts, mostly "otics" in antipsychotics and antimycotics, and "icine" in colchicine.

modes.label: Drug-class endings
modes.description: The closing piece of antipsychotics or antimycotics after the opening part.

modes.label: Colchicine ending
modes.description: The final piece of colchicine in interaction lists and text.
modes.example: concomitant use of colch<<icine>> with pravastatin sodium.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Occasional closing pieces of other medical words, such as rigidity.

card.plain: It fires on the last part of a long drug name, such as antipsychotics or colchicine, once the word is nearly complete.
